title: UC Experiment — Synthetic Data Augmentation for Ulcerative Colitis Severity Prediction
summary: A research pipeline studying how imputation methods and synthetic data augmentation (SMOTE, ADASYN, CTGAN, TVAE and hybrid combinations) affect classification of ulcerative colitis severity from 251 patients' lab test data. It uses SDV's single-table CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer, driven via SingleTableMetadata, as the generative augmentation strategies compared against classical oversampling methods and a no-augmentation baseline.
